name: Dirk van der Meer
bio:
Dirk's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for Formula 1, nurtured by weekend races and countless hours spent building model cars. He honed his marketing skills at a local advertising agency before making the leap to JHR Developments five years ago. Dirk views marketing not just as promotion, but as a crucial link connecting the team's technical prowess with their fanbase and sponsors. He's known for his meticulous approach and creative campaigns, always striving to capture the essence of speed and competition. 

He believes in data-driven strategies combined with innovative storytelling. Dirk is always looking for new ways to engage audiences, from interactive social media campaigns to behind-the-scenes documentary series. His dedication to detail and passion for motorsport make him a valuable asset to JHR Developments, ensuring their brand stands out on and off the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Dirk is of average height with a slightly athletic build, often seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen for jotting down ideas.
Refuses to start a meeting without first offering everyone stroopwafels.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
